author: Veli Raiya
title: Looking for fantasy book map designer + character illustrator
content: Looking for a fantasy book map designer + character illustrator! 👀 Definitely doesn’t have to be the same artist for both. Bonus points if you’re a fantasy author recommending someone you’ve personally worked with because I know the bots are about to find me 😂 See the next posts for more details on what I’m looking for with each! 🤍 For character art, I tend to gravitate toward more realistic, epic fantasy concept art, as opposed to a cartoon illustration. My book is on the lighter side of fantasy, but I love art that still feels grounded and lifelike. I’m definitely open to seeing different styles though, so please share your work/recs! Bonus points if you can do POC and a wide variety of ethnicities! For the map, I’d love something detailed and immersive with that classic fantasy-map feel, but I’m pretty open stylistically! It’s a very visual world, I’m so excited to describe it to someone 🎨 Thanks in advance!! Contact: share work/recs in thread or DM.

author: La Biblioteca Dracónica / maitespena
title: Se buscan ilustradores for book character promo art
content: 🚨Se buscan ilustradores 📢 Busco quien nos ilustre una serie de personajes, teniendo en cuenta que no todos serán humanos. Son imágenes para redes sociales, para promocionar nuestro libro. No para venderlas ni para ilustrar páginas. Sencillas, de personajes a solas o en grupo (se pedirán varias). Por favor, agradecería que añadierais vuestro portfolio y una lista de precios. También podéis escribirme en privado si lo preferís. Gracias. Añado: Todos los personajes que se van a dibujar son adultos, pero algunos no son humanos (hay algunos tipos de demonios y seres mágicos entre ellos). Es una novela adulta. Buscamos algo que tenga un toque más bien sencillo porque el libro tiene mucho humor. Contact: comment portfolio + price list or private message.

author: nrfrh_azn
title: Looking for illustrator for YA fantasy novel book covers
content: 🎨 Calling all fantasy illustrators! I’m looking for an illustrator for my upcoming YA fantasy novel. Think dark academia, ancient magic, mysterious towers and an elegant, atmospheric fantasy aesthetic. ✨ If you create fantasy book covers, I’d love to see your portfolio! Please DM me your artwork, rates and estimated turnaround time. Recommendations are welcome too! Contact: DM portfolio, rates, turnaround.
